full_judgment: 6. The defendant petitioner being the Government of Bangladesh, represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka contested the suit by filing written statement contending inter alia that the owner of the property migrated to India for good before 1965 and the property was vested with the Government as per law and that the RS Khatian No. 390 was recorded with a note that Brojo Mohon was leaving in India.
